channel.title: Yaprflow Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Yaprflow for Mac.

item.description:
# Yaprflow 5.2.10
This release improves AI output reliability across supported providers:
- OpenAI, OpenRouter, and Ollama responses now use provider-compatible output limits. - Yaprflow automatically retries once with a larger response budget when a model stops before finishing. - Meeting summaries and transcript actions have more room to complete longer, structured results. - Provider errors remain concise and never expose the full service response.
Dictation, meeting recording, local storage, and privacy behavior are unchanged.

# Yaprflow 5.2.9
This maintenance release polishes provider setup and update settings:
- API keys can now be pasted normally with Command-V or the standard Edit menu. - Update settings are reduced to a clear version row, a Check Now action, and one automatic-updates switch. - Automatic updates now use one control for both checking and downloading.
Dictation, meeting recording, and saved notes are unchanged.

# Yaprflow 5.2.8
This maintenance release makes AI-generated meeting outputs more reliable:
- Action plans and meeting summaries now recover cleanly when an AI provider returns truncated or slightly malformed structured output. - Structured output is rendered as native Yaprflow sections instead of exposing raw JSON in the meeting view. - Existing saved meetings containing a raw structured response are repaired automatically when they are reopened. - Unrecoverable structured output now produces a clear retry state rather than being displayed as meeting content.
Quick Dictation and the meeting transcription workflow are unchanged.
